test_run_random_simulations: test the HangmanTest class by running random simulations with chance node word selection
test_run_random_simulations_fixed_words: test the HangmanTest class by running random simulations with specific fixed words like pineapple and pizza
test_word_with_spaces: test the HangmanTest class by guessing letters in a word with spaces and verifying correct rewards
test_all_incorrect_guesses: test the HangmanTest class by making all incorrect guesses and verifying terminal state returns minimum utility
